page.text:
Every bijective function $f : A \to B$ admits a unique two-sided *inverse
function* $f^{-1} : B \to A$ that completely reverses its action,
satisfying $f^{-1} \circ f = \text{id}_A$ and
$f \circ f^{-1} = \text{id}_B$.
